summary: A drop zone for files, in three shapes, dashed or solid, with an error message and an optional line for formats and limits.

props.name: label
props.description: The clickable part of the prompt, before "or drag and drop".

props.name: hint
props.description: The quieter line under the prompt, for what this zone accepts.

props.name: description
props.description: A line outside the zone, for formats and limits. Replaced by `error`'s message when it is set.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the cloud glyph in the tile. It is sized and coloured by the zone, so pass the glyph and nothing else.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the icon tile, not on the zone: a drop target with a drop shadow reads as a card you cannot drop into.

props.name: border
props.description: `dashed` is the drop-zone convention and carries the extra width it needs to read as one. `solid` is a heavier, more permanent box, so it stays thin.

props.name: error
props.description: Turns the border, tile and text red & shows this message in place of `description`. Crosses with `border`, so a solid zone can be in error too.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction, dims the zone and fills it, so it reads as unavailable rather than merely empty.
